feeds.title: ACIS Educational Tours Blog
feeds.description: ACIS provides exceptional educational travel opportunities for teacher-led student groups. The ACIS tours travel blog features travel inspiration, trip planning for students and teachers, interviews with ACIS team members and so much more!

feeds.title: NationsClassroom Blog
feeds.description: NationsClassroom is a trusted educational travel company specializing in school trips to our nation's historic corridor, including class trips to Washington, D.C., New York City, Boston, Philadelphia, and neighboring areas. We help educators to inspire students through meaningful travel experiences. And provide educational, safe, affordable, and fun trip. On the NationsClassroom Tours Blog, we offer details about our destinations, attraction guides, and trip leader tips!

feeds.title: Travelbound Blog
feeds.description: Travelbound has been operating for more than 30 years, and so have a wealth of experience organizing educational school trips, university tours, music, performing arts tours and having fun within the UK and overseas. It consists of a friendly, passionate team of travel and education experts. They also supply safe, high-quality, competitively-priced tours and every part of the tour is relevant and engaging for students.

feeds.title: EF Tours Blog
feeds.description: EF Tours is your resource for educational travel. Our mission is to open the world through education. Our educational tours help prepare students for the future by teaching them more about the world, themselves, and their place in the world. Our goal is to increase access to travel-based learning by expanding and diversifying our community of schools, educators, and students to create an intercultural educational experience for all learners.

feeds.title: Educational Tours Blog
feeds.description: The Educational Tours Blog is the best way to keep up with the latest trends in educational student travel, news and stories from the road by our team and travelers. This site is dedicated to sharing the world of student educational class trips with our many schools, teachers, sponsors, chaperones and website visitors.

feeds.title: Group Tour magazine
feeds.description: Student Group Tour magazine presents ideas for educators and tour planners to develop educational travel for middle and secondary/high school students.

feeds.title: WorldStrides Blog
feeds.description: WorldStrides, the nation's largest accredited travel organization helps students of all ages see the world and see themselves in new ways with educational travel and experiences. The blog features student stories, teacher resources, and interesting facts related to our student travel destinations, as well as important updates for parents, teachers, and students about WorldStrides.

feeds.title: eTurboNews » Educational Travel
feeds.description: eTurboNews provides all the latest news in the education sector, visit our website to learn more. We offer the most reliable source of education-related tourism news online.

feeds.title: Educational Travel Consultants Blog
feeds.description: Educational Travel Consultants has been serving the student travel market for over 32 years. Since 1984, ETC has helped hundreds of thousands of students deepen their educational experience by providing quality educational travel. Student Groups who travel with Educational Travel Consultants have ensured the most economic pricing per student.
